final: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.length) AS avg_length, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film f WHERE f.length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.rating), cross_rating_mean AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_price FROM rating_stats), above_mean AS (SELECT rs.avg_length, rs.per_day_price, crm.mean_price FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN cross_rating_mean crm WHERE rs.per_day_price > crm.mean_price) SELECT AVG(above_mean.avg_length) AS avg_of_avg_lengths, AVG(above_mean.per_day_price) AS avg_of_per_day_prices, AVG(above_mean.per_day_price - above_mean.mean_price) AS avg_excess FROM above_mean
